Mass 0.853 +/- 0.038 solar masses from Maciejewski et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-84 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.525L..43M/abstract). entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,300 K and log g 4.6 (u1 0.574, u2 0.183): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
